name: @map-audio/pam-mcp-server

tools.name: get_parameter_info
tools.description: Look up PAM parameter definitions from the manifest. Returns ranges, defaults, display names, and tooltips. Use this to understand what parameters are available before setting values.

paramId.description: Specific parameter ID (e.g. 'cell1_filterCutoff'). Omit for all.

cell.description: Filter by cell (e.g. 'cell1'). Returns all params for that cell.

search.description: Search term to filter parameters by name or ID.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List available PAM presets (factory and user).

tools.name: read_preset
tools.description: Read a PAM preset file and return its state. Useful for understanding what parameters a preset uses, what samples it references, etc.

path.description: Preset file path (absolute or relative to preset dirs).

summary.description: If true, return only metadata + parameter summary instead of full state.

tools.name: get_manifest_summary
tools.description: Get a high-level summary of PAM's capabilities: number of cells, effects, modulators, and parameter counts.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read the current full state of the running PAM plugin. Returns all parameter values, cell configs, modulation, and sequences.

section.description: Return only a specific section of state. Defaults to 'full'. Use get_transport for transport data.

tools.name: set_parameters
tools.description: Set one or more PAM parameters. Values are validated against the manifest. Use get_parameter_info first to discover valid parameter IDs and ranges.

parameters.description: Map of paramId to value. Example: { 'cell1_filterCutoff': 5000, 'cell1_filterQ': 0.7 }

tools.name: load_sample
tools.description: Load an audio file (wav, mp3, aif, flac) into a PAM cell.

filePath.description: Path to the audio file (absolute, or relative as returned by list_samples).

tools.name: download_model
tools.description: Start (or resume) downloading model weights for an AI engine. Async — returns immediately with download progress; poll get_model_status. aigen + notochord auto-load on completion; magenta needs a separate load_model. Requires the engine's experimental flags.

engine.description: Which AI engine. notochord = MIDI co-player (~18 MB blob); aigen = Stable Audio 3 sample generation (~3.2 GB ONNX); magenta = MagentaRT realtime audio (Apple Silicon, MLX).

model.description: Magenta only: which variant (base = 2.4B, needs ~M2 Max/M3 Pro+; small = 230M, default). Ignored for notochord/aigen (single model).

tools.name: get_model_status
tools.description: Report downloaded / loaded / loading / download-in-flight + version + disk size + live download progress for an AI engine.

engine.description: Which AI engine. notochord = MIDI co-player (~18 MB blob); aigen = Stable Audio 3 sample generation (~3.2 GB ONNX); magenta = MagentaRT realtime audio (Apple Silicon, MLX).

tools.name: load_model
tools.description: Load a downloaded model into memory (async — poll get_model_status for loaded:true). Use after unload, or for magenta after download. magenta accepts an optional variant; omit to load whichever is on disk.

engine.description: Which AI engine. notochord = MIDI co-player (~18 MB blob); aigen = Stable Audio 3 sample generation (~3.2 GB ONNX); magenta = MagentaRT realtime audio (Apple Silicon, MLX).

model.description: Magenta only: which variant (base = 2.4B, needs ~M2 Max/M3 Pro+; small = 230M, default). Ignored for notochord/aigen (single model).

tools.name: unload_model
tools.description: Free the loaded model from memory (weights stay on disk). May briefly stall the plugin while an in-flight load finishes (non-interruptible ORT/MLX load).

engine.description: Which AI engine. notochord = MIDI co-player (~18 MB blob); aigen = Stable Audio 3 sample generation (~3.2 GB ONNX); magenta = MagentaRT realtime audio (Apple Silicon, MLX).

tools.name: delete_model
tools.description: Delete downloaded model weights from disk. Unloads first automatically. DESTRUCTIVE — re-download to restore. magenta delete is variant-agnostic (removes both variants + shared resources).

engine.description: Which AI engine. notochord = MIDI co-player (~18 MB blob); aigen = Stable Audio 3 sample generation (~3.2 GB ONNX); magenta = MagentaRT realtime audio (Apple Silicon, MLX).

model.description: Magenta only: which variant (base = 2.4B, needs ~M2 Max/M3 Pro+; small = 230M, default). Ignored for notochord/aigen (single model).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List available model variants per engine with downloaded / loaded state. Omit engine to list all engines (notochord, aigen, magenta base + small).

engine.description: Which AI engine. notochord = MIDI co-player (~18 MB blob); aigen = Stable Audio 3 sample generation (~3.2 GB ONNX); magenta = MagentaRT realtime audio (Apple Silicon, MLX).

tools.name: generate_sample
tools.description: Generate a new audio sample via the on-device AI engine (Stable Audio 3 Small SFX, ~3.2 GB ONNX). The plugin must have the model downloaded first (Settings → Local models). Returns the on-disk path to the generated WAV and optionally loads it into a cell.

category.description: Sound category — drives prompt template defaults.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired sound.

durationSeconds.description: Output length in seconds (Stable Audio 3 Small SFX engine cap ≈ 47 s). For loops, pass bar-converted duration: bars * beatsPerBar * 60 / bpm.

mode.description: Generation mode. text = unconditional, inpaint = audio-to-audio with mask, continuation = extend existing audio.

cellId.description: If provided, load result directly into this cell.

refAudioPath.description: Required for inpaint/continuation. Absolute path to a WAV.

maskSpec.description: Mask spec for inpaint mode: "tail:0.5" or "transient:0-0.05" or "full".

tools.name: generate_kit
tools.description: Generate multiple AI samples in parallel (Stable Audio 3 Small SFX) and load them into a list of cells. Useful for building a coherent drum / instrument kit from a single high-level prompt. Requires the on-device model to be downloaded (Settings → Local models).

prompt.description: High-level kit description (e.g. "dark trap drum kit", "lofi house").

cells.description: Cells to populate. Each gets one sample matching the role.

tools.name: workbench_get_state
tools.description: Read the AI Audio Workbench canvas state AND the take shelf: { state: { sourceCellId, prompt, seed, seedLocked, sigma, steps, maskRegions, strengthCurve, activeSourcePath, sketchPath, sketchGain }, takes: [...] }.

tools.name: workbench_set_state
tools.description: Partial-merge the Workbench canvas state (only the keys you pass change). Also pushes the merged state into an open Workbench UI. Returns the full merged state.

sourceCellId.description: Cell whose sample is the transform source (null to clear).

seedLocked.description: Lock seed across renders (iterate at fixed identity).

sigma.description: Deviation σ / init noise level. a2a: 0.25-0.35 preserves melody, 0.45-0.5 variation; inpaint regime ~0.85.

steps.description: Denoise steps (8 is the validated recipe).

endSec.description: Region end in seconds (must be > startSec).

lowHz.description: Optional band low edge in Hz (canvas v2 2D mask). Omit BOTH lowHz/highHz for a full-band region (1D back-compat).

highHz.description: Optional band high edge in Hz (must be > lowHz). lowHz<=20 && highHz>=source nyquist is treated as full band by the sidecar.

maskRegions.description: Transform-lane mask. Empty = pure a2a re-render of the whole source; regions = inpaint (regenerate inside, keep outside). Regions may carry an optional lowHz/highHz band.

strengthCurve.description: Strength-lane breakpoints (stored with full provenance; per-region σ application is experimental).

activeSourcePath.description: Render-chain head: absolute WAV path used as the transform source ('' = the source cell's sample). Managed automatically — each successful render advances it to the new take's wavPath; set explicitly only to point the chain at a prior take. Walk it back with workbench_undo / workbench_reset_chain.

sketchPath.description: SKETCH mode: absolute path to a painted-gesture WAV ('' = no sketch). Normally written by the UI (workbenchSaveSketch saves into ai-cache/workbench/); settable directly for headless tests. When non-empty, renders feed the model source + sketch*sketchGain as init audio AND use that MIX as the preservation reference for masks/paste-back — the gesture survives outside masked regions.

sketchGain.description: SKETCH mix gain 0..1 (default 0.5) applied to the sketch before summing with the source. If the mix peaks above 0.99 the sidecar scales the whole mix down to 0.99.

tools.name: workbench_render
tools.description: Render the Workbench transform via the SA3 sidecar and append the result to the take shelf. Renders the CURRENT canvas state merged with any overrides passed here (overrides do not persist). Blocks until done (up to ~3 min: pipeline rebuilds + multi-region inpaints render sequentially). Returns the take { id, wavPath, prompt, seed, sigma, maskRegions, createdAt, sourceCellId, durationSeconds, error? }. Source resolution: sourcePath override > activeSourcePath (chain head) > state.sourceCellId's sample file. A successful render ADVANCES the chain (activeSourcePath = new take's wavPath) — step back with workbench_undo or workbench_reset_chain.

sourceCellId.description: Cell whose sample is the transform source (null to clear).

seedLocked.description: Lock seed across renders (iterate at fixed identity).

sigma.description: Deviation σ / init noise level. a2a: 0.25-0.35 preserves melody, 0.45-0.5 variation; inpaint regime ~0.85.

steps.description: Denoise steps (8 is the validated recipe).

endSec.description: Region end in seconds (must be > startSec).

lowHz.description: Optional band low edge in Hz (canvas v2 2D mask). Omit BOTH lowHz/highHz for a full-band region (1D back-compat).

highHz.description: Optional band high edge in Hz (must be > lowHz). lowHz<=20 && highHz>=source nyquist is treated as full band by the sidecar.

maskRegions.description: Transform-lane mask. Empty = pure a2a re-render of the whole source; regions = inpaint (regenerate inside, keep outside). Regions may carry an optional lowHz/highHz band.

strengthCurve.description: Strength-lane breakpoints (stored with full provenance; per-region σ application is experimental).

activeSourcePath.description: Render-chain head: absolute WAV path used as the transform source ('' = the source cell's sample). Managed automatically — each successful render advances it to the new take's wavPath; set explicitly only to point the chain at a prior take. Walk it back with workbench_undo / workbench_reset_chain.

sketchPath.description: SKETCH mode: absolute path to a painted-gesture WAV ('' = no sketch). Normally written by the UI (workbenchSaveSketch saves into ai-cache/workbench/); settable directly for headless tests. When non-empty, renders feed the model source + sketch*sketchGain as init audio AND use that MIX as the preservation reference for masks/paste-back — the gesture survives outside masked regions.

sketchGain.description: SKETCH mix gain 0..1 (default 0.5) applied to the sketch before summing with the source. If the mix peaks above 0.99 the sidecar scales the whole mix down to 0.99.

sourcePath.description: Absolute path to a source WAV — bypasses sourceCellId resolution.

tools.name: workbench_list_takes
tools.description: List all Workbench takes (renders) with full provenance, oldest first.

tools.name: workbench_load_take
tools.description: Load a rendered take's WAV into a cell (same native path as load_sample).

tools.name: workbench_undo
tools.description: Pop the Workbench render chain one step: restores the previous chain head (activeSourcePath) so the next render re-transforms the prior source. No-op at the chain root (cell sample). Takes are kept. Returns the full { state, takes }.

tools.name: workbench_reset_chain
tools.description: Clear the Workbench render chain: empties the undo stack and resets the source back to the cell sample (activeSourcePath = ''). Takes are kept. Returns the full { state, takes }.

tools.name: workbench_sidecar_status
tools.description: Ping the SA3 render sidecar (127.0.0.1:8093). Returns { connected, loaded } — loaded means a pipeline is resident (first render after a cold start also pays the model load).

tools.name: trigger_midi
tools.description: Send a MIDI note to a specific cell or globally. When cellId is omitted, the note is routed through the same MIDI-mapping logic the DAW uses — cells with matching note + channel mappings receive it. Use for previewing sounds or triggering one-shots.

cellId.description: Target cell (1-8). Omit to route globally via MIDI mappings.

noteOn.description: true for note on, false for note off.

tools.name: stop_cell
tools.description: Stop playback of a specific cell.

tools.name: load_preset
tools.description: Load a preset into the running PAM plugin.

path.description: Preset file path (absolute or relative to preset dirs).

tools.name: add_modulation
tools.description: Add a modulation link (LFO, envelope follower, or vary) to a parameter. The parameter must be modulatable (check with get_parameter_info).

lfoIndex.description: LFO generator index (0-5). Required for LFO type.

pitch.description: Envelope only: route from the cell's pitch-tracked source instead of amp. false (default) = AMP; true & pitchDuck=false = BOOST; true & pitchDuck=true = DUCK.

pitchDuck.description: Envelope only: when pitch=true, switch from BOOST to DUCK semantics (notch). Ignored if pitch=false.

tools.name: update_pattern
tools.description: Write a note, pitch, slice, or stretch sequence to a cell's pattern sequencer.

sequence.description: Array of sequence events. For 'note': [{time, note, duration, velocity, prob}]. For 'pitch'/'slice'/'stretch': [{time, value, duration}].

tools.name: randomize
tools.description: Trigger PAM's randomization engine to generate random sounds and patterns.

cellIds.description: Specific cells to randomize. Omit for all.

genreHint.description: Genre hint to guide sample selection (e.g. 'techno', 'hip-hop').

bpmHint.description: BPM hint to influence pattern generation.

mutationAmount.description: Mutation amount for pattern randomization (0-1). Lower = subtler changes.

tools.name: randomize_samples
tools.description: Use PAM's native sample randomization engine to pick coherent samples based on genre, BPM, and kit role. More musically coherent than manually browsing and loading samples. Supports folder filtering to constrain selection to specific sample packs.

cellIds.description: Specific cells to randomize. Omit for all cells.

genreHint.description: Genre hint to guide sample selection. Supported: techno, house, trap, boom_bap, drill, dnb, hip-hop, ambient, industrial, breaks.

bpmHint.description: BPM hint — samples near this tempo are preferred.

excludedFolders.description: Folder names to exclude from sample selection (e.g. ['Loops', 'Vocals']).

allowedSamplePaths.description: If provided, only pick samples from these paths. Overrides default library scan.

tools.name: randomize_patterns
tools.description: Use PAM's native pattern generation engine to create musically coherent note patterns based on genre and BPM. Analyzes loaded samples to determine roles (kick, snare, hat, etc.) and generates appropriate rhythms.

cellIds.description: Specific cells to randomize patterns for. Omit for all cells.

genreHint.description: Genre hint to guide pattern generation (e.g. 'techno', 'hip-hop', 'dnb').

bpmHint.description: BPM hint to influence pattern timing and density.

mutationAmount.description: How much to vary from typical patterns (0 = conventional, 1 = experimental). Default ~0.5.

tools.name: load_variation
tools.description: Switch to a saved variation slot (0-7). Loads the stored state for that variation including parameters, effects, patterns, and modulation. The preset must have variations saved via save_variation first.

index.description: Variation slot index (0-7). PAM UI shows these as slots 1-8.

tools.name: full_stop_transport
tools.description: Stop transport and reset playhead position to zero. Unlike stop_transport (which pauses), this resets the position so playback starts from the beginning.

tools.name: get_transport
tools.description: Get current transport state (BPM, playing, position).

tools.name: new_preset
tools.description: Reset PAM to its initial/default state — equivalent to creating a new empty preset. All cells, modulation, sequences, and effects are cleared.

tools.name: save_preset
tools.description: Save the current PAM state as a new preset file with metadata. Writes to the user preset folder by default; pass `path` for a specific location. Use `update_preset_metadata` to edit an existing preset without re-saving plugin state.

name.description: Preset name (used for filename if `path` omitted).

bpm.description: BPM the preset was designed for.

image.description: Relative path to a visual/thumbnail saved via set_visual.

path.description: Relative preset path (e.g. 'Presets/User/MyFolder/MyPreset.preset'). Factory paths are rejected. Defaults to user preset folder + name + '.preset'.

tools.name: save_variation
tools.description: Capture the current plugin state and save it to a variation slot (0-7). Use this to build presets with multiple variations — e.g., a build-up from minimal to full. Configure the plugin state first (load samples, set parameters, enable effects, add modulation), then call save_variation to snapshot it into a slot. The preset must have been saved at least once via save_preset before calling this, or pass a name to create it.

name.description: Preset name. Required if the preset hasn't been saved yet. If omitted, re-saves the currently active preset.

tools.name: update_preset_metadata
tools.description: Update metadata fields on an existing preset file without touching its DSP state or the currently loaded plugin. Merges the provided fields into the preset's metadata on disk. Returns {success, newPath?} on success, or {conflict, existingPath} if a rename would collide with another preset. Factory presets cannot be modified.

path.description: Relative preset path (e.g. 'Presets/User/MyPreset.preset'), as returned by list_presets or save_preset.

name.description: New preset name (renames the file on disk).

image.description: Relative path to a visual/thumbnail saved via set_visual.

tools.name: start_transport
tools.description: Start PAM's internal transport (begins sequencer playback).

tools.name: stop_transport
tools.description: Stop PAM's internal transport (stops sequencer playback).

tools.name: set_bpm
tools.description: Set PAM's internal transport BPM.

tools.name: trim_sample
tools.description: Trim a cell's sample to its start/end markers (non-destructive crop).

tools.name: reverse_sample
tools.description: Reverse a cell's loaded sample.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Check if the MCP server can connect to a running PAM plugin instance. Returns connection details or instructions for enabling the bridge.

tools.name: list_samples
tools.description: Browse sample library directories. IMPORTANT: Do NOT guess paths — always call get_default_locations first to discover the actual library paths, then use those paths here. Paths vary per user and platform.

path.description: Directory path to list. MUST be a path returned by get_default_locations or a subdirectory of one. Do not guess paths like ~/Music/PAM.

audioOnly.description: If true, only show audio files and directories (default: true).

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for pagination). Default: 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (1-200). Default: 50.

tools.name: get_default_locations
tools.description: Get PAM's known library paths (samples, media, presets). Use these paths with list_samples to browse the sample library.

tools.name: get_audio_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about an audio file: sample rate, channels, bit depth, duration, format name, and metadata tags. Works with WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, OGG, M4A. Useful for analyzing exported renders or checking samples before loading.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the audio file.

tools.name: export_preset
tools.description: Export a preset as a zip file bundled with all referenced samples. Creates a shareable preset package.

presetPath.description: Preset path (relative to PAM library, as returned by list_presets or save_preset).

outputFolderName.description: Name for the output zip folder (without extension).

tools.name: import_preset
tools.description: Import a preset from a zip file or folder into PAM's preset library.

path.description: Absolute path to the preset zip file or folder to import.

tools.name: set_visual
tools.description: Save an image file as a preset visual/thumbnail in PAM's media library. Accepts an absolute file path to an image (png, jpg, gif, webp).

filePath.description: Absolute path to the image file.

name.description: Preferred filename for the saved visual.

tools.name: list_visuals
tools.description: List all visual/thumbnail files in PAM's media library. Returns name, relative path, MIME type, size, and modification time for each visual.

tools.name: delete_visual
tools.description: Delete a visual file from PAM's user media library. Only files in the user media folder can be deleted (not factory visuals).

path.description: Relative path to the visual (as returned by list_visuals or set_visual).

tools.name: get_visual_data_url
tools.description: Read a visual file from PAM's media library and return it as a base64 data URL. Useful for previewing or inspecting visual content.

path.description: Relative path to the visual (as returned by list_visuals or set_visual).

maxBytes.description: Maximum file size in bytes (default 5MB). Files exceeding this are rejected.

tools.name: import_visual_folder
tools.description: Bulk-import all valid visual files from a folder into PAM's user media library. The import runs asynchronously; this tool returns immediately once the import is queued.

folderPath.description: Absolute path to the folder containing visual files to import.

operationId.description: Optional operation ID for tracking import progress.

tools.name: get_video_state
tools.description: Read the full VX video scene: layers (in render order, top-first) with their per-layer FX chains, the output/global FX chain, audio-reactive bindings, mod-matrix routes, the 3D model overlay, the active cell, and global render/sync settings. Layer/FX/binding ids returned here are what the other video tools address. If `available` is false, open PAM's window so the video UI mounts.

tools.name: capture_ui
tools.description: Render PAM's plugin UI (#app_root) to a PNG via html2canvas and return the saved file path (read it to view the image). Optionally compose the view first: gridSize (1|4|8), mainView (CellGrid|CtrlAll|Envelope|LFO|Vary|Mixer|SongMode|Video|PresetBrowser; omit/null = cell grid), instrumentView ('synth'|'sampler', applied to all cells). REQUIRES PAM's window OPEN — html2canvas needs the live DOM, there is no headless renderer (same constraint as the video tools). Beats screen-capture: deterministic, no cursor/screen control, exact UI bitmap.

gridSize.description: Cell grid size to set before capture: 1, 4, or 8.

mainView.description: Main view to switch to before capture (CellGrid, Mixer, LFO, …). Omit for the cell grid.

instrumentView.description: Switch all cells to the synth or sampler tab before capture.

settleMs.description: Delay (ms) after view changes before rasterizing. Default 350.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms to wait for the WebView to return the image.

tools.name: video_command
tools.description: Escape hatch to the full video command router — pass any { op, ...args } object. Use the dedicated tools (add_video_layer, set_video_fx, bind_video_param, …) when one fits; this reaches everything else. Ops: addLayer{kind,name?,insertAt?}, removeLayer{layerId}, updateLayer{layerId,patch}, moveLayer{layerId,toIndex}, duplicateLayer{layerId}, renameLayer{layerId,name}, setLayerEnabled{layerId,enabled?}, toggleSolo{layerId}, selectLayer{layerId}, resetLayer{layerId}, applyLayout{preset}, randomizeLayer{layerId}; addLayerFx{layerId,fxType,params?,beforeFxId?}, removeLayerFx{layerId,fxId}, removeAllLayerFx{layerId}, setLayerFxParam{layerId,fxId,param,value|params}, setLayerFxEnabled{layerId,fxId,enabled?}, reorderLayerFx{layerId,fxIds}, resetLayerFx{layerId,fxId}; bind{layerId,fxId?,paramKey,source,...}, unbind{layerId,fxId?,paramKey}, setBindingField{layerId,fxId?,paramKey,field,value}, fireImpulse{layerId,fxId?,paramKey}, removeBindingsForLayer{layerId}, clearBindings; addOutputFx{fxId}, removeOutputFx{instanceId}, setOutputFxParam{instanceId|fxId,param,value}, setOutputFxEnabled{instanceId,enabled}, setOutputFxStrength{instanceId,strength}; addModRoute{route}, removeModRoute{id}, updateModRoute{id,updates}, clearModRoutes, setModEnabled{enabled}; setModel{sourcePath?,visible?,blendMode?,audioReactive?,autoRotate?,transform?}, resetModel; setSettings{...}, setActiveCell{cellId}, resetWorkspace. Layer fx target a per-layer chain; output fx target the global chain (ids differ). Pass `source` as a sourceKey string: `g:<id>` global (level, bandLow, bandMid, bandHigh, transient, transientLow, transientMid, transientHigh, bpm, spectralCentroid, spectralFlux, stereoWidth, varyActivity, phraseLevel, phraseBass, looperBus, masterOnsetLow/Mid/High, masterStereoWidth, masterPanScalar, masterFullMix, masterCompressorGR, sidechainLevel, sidechainEnv); `t:<phase>` transport (beat, bar, phrase); `c:<cell>:<field>` per-cell (level, envFollow, pulse, onset, spectrumPeak, spectrumCentroid, pitch, postFaderL/R, samplerRMSL/R, synthRMS, beatPosition, activeRetriggers, grainActivity, grainPos, grainSpread, grainPitch, grainPitchSpread, grainReverseRatio); `l:<track>:level` looper; `lf:<lfo>:rate|phase` LFO; `p:<paramId>` any DAW param (e.g. p:macro_1). Or a structured object e.g. {kind:'cell',cellIndex:1,field:'onset'}.

command.description: The command object. Must include a string `op` field.

tools.name: add_video_layer
tools.description: Add a layer to the VX scene and return its id. Kinds: video, image, camera, text, drawing, model3d, adjustment (adjustment = full-canvas FX only; master is a managed singleton and cannot be added). After adding, set its source/props with update_video_layer and stack FX with add_video_fx.

insertAt.description: Data-index to insert at (default: top of stack).

tools.name: update_video_layer
tools.description: Update a layer's common props and/or kind-specific fields. transform is merged (partial) against the current transform; other fields replace. Common: opacity (0..1), blendMode (normal|add|multiply|screen), enabled, name, transform {x,y(0..1),scale,rotation(rad),anchor}. Kind-specific via `fields`: text layers {text,fontSize,fontWeight,color,align,lineHeight}; image/video/model3d {sourcePath,fit}; camera {deviceId,mirror,fit}; drawing {paintColor,paintWidth}; model3d {lightingMode,lightIntensity,rotateRateX/Y/Z,...}. Use get_video_state to see a layer's current fields.

fields.description: Kind-specific fields (text, sourcePath, fit, fontSize, color, …).

tools.name: remove_video_layer
tools.description: Remove a layer (and its FX + bindings). The master layer cannot be removed.

tools.name: apply_video_layout
tools.description: Arrange the spatial layers with a layout preset: centered (stacked), grid, columns, rows, or focus (one large + thumbnail strip). adjustment and master layers are untouched.

tools.name: add_video_fx
tools.description: Append an FX to a layer's chain (target='layer', needs layerId) or to the output/global chain (target='output'), and return the new id. Per-layer FX: hueRotate, glow, audioReact, vibration, chromaticAberration, pixelate, rgbShift, mirror, trails(drawing/text), beam(drawing/text), shake, rolls, barrelBlur, edge, halftone, patches, brightnessContrast, lines, feedback, warp, datamosh, slicer, polarSlitScan, cellVoronoi, spectralZones, paletteLut, asciiDither, pixelSort, cameraShake, blur. Output FX: lines, barrelBlur, brightnessContrast, edge, glow, shake, rgbShift, halftone, mirror, patches, pixelate, rolls, feedback, warp, datamosh, slicer, positionXY, speed, cellVoronoi, polarSlitScan, spectralZones, audioReact. FX params seed from registry defaults; override via `params`. Use set_video_fx to tweak afterwards.

fxType.description: FX id (see the per-layer / output id lists).

beforeFxId.description: Insert before this fx id instead of appending (layer target only).

tools.name: set_video_fx
tools.description: Set FX params / enabled / strength on a per-layer FX (target='layer', needs layerId + fxId) or an output FX (target='output', needs instanceId, or fxId to auto-create). Pass a single {param,value}, multiple {params}, `enabled`, and/or `strength` (output only). Get current ids/params from get_video_state.

fxId.description: Layer fx id, or output fxId (auto-creates the output fx).

instanceId.description: target='output': the output fx instance id.

strength.description: Output FX wet strength (output target only).

tools.name: remove_video_fx
tools.description: Remove an FX from a layer chain (target='layer' + layerId + fxId) or the output chain (target='output' + instanceId).

fxId.description: target='layer': fx id on the layer.

tools.name: bind_video_param
tools.description: Bind a per-layer FX param or layer field to an audio/transport source so it reacts to the music. Omit fxId (or pass '') to target a layer field: transform.x, transform.y, transform.scale, transform.rotation, opacity, hue, brightness, contrast, saturation, playbackRate, fontSize, pulseAmount, or model3d fields. Pass fxId to target an FX param (param key from that FX). Pass `source` as a sourceKey string: `g:<id>` global (level, bandLow, bandMid, bandHigh, transient, transientLow, transientMid, transientHigh, bpm, spectralCentroid, spectralFlux, stereoWidth, varyActivity, phraseLevel, phraseBass, looperBus, masterOnsetLow/Mid/High, masterStereoWidth, masterPanScalar, masterFullMix, masterCompressorGR, sidechainLevel, sidechainEnv); `t:<phase>` transport (beat, bar, phrase); `c:<cell>:<field>` per-cell (level, envFollow, pulse, onset, spectrumPeak, spectrumCentroid, pitch, postFaderL/R, samplerRMSL/R, synthRMS, beatPosition, activeRetriggers, grainActivity, grainPos, grainSpread, grainPitch, grainPitchSpread, grainReverseRatio); `l:<track>:level` looper; `lf:<lfo>:rate|phase` LFO; `p:<paramId>` any DAW param (e.g. p:macro_1). Or a structured object e.g. {kind:'cell',cellIndex:1,field:'onset'}. amount is -1..1; curve linear|exp|expInverse|bipolar; mode additive|replace|multiply|centered; impulse off|pulse|latch (one-shot on threshold crossing). attack/release default per-source if omitted.

paramKey.description: FX param key, or layer field (e.g. transform.scale, opacity).

fxId.description: FX instance id; omit/'' for a layer-field target.

tools.name: set_video_settings
tools.description: Set global VX render/sync settings: syncMode (off|beat-sync|beat-match), loopBars, aspectRatio (auto|16:9|4:3|1:1|stretch), renderQuality (low|medium|high), designAspect (w/h number or null), letterboxColor / canvasColor (#hex), the active video cell (cellId), and the mod-matrix master enable. resetWorkspace clears the scene (preserves the master layer).

activeCell.description: Switch the active per-cell video slice.

resetWorkspace.description: If true, clear the whole scene first.

tools.name: reset_cell
tools.description: Reset all parameters of a single cell to their default values and remove any envelopes targeting this cell. Does not touch other cells.

tools.name: copy_cell
tools.description: Copy all parameters and modulation from one cell to another. Overwrites the target cell's settings.

tools.name: clear_modulations
tools.description: Remove all LFO, envelope, and vary modulation links targeting a cell's parameters (or originating from that cell, for envelopes/vary). Useful for starting fresh on a cell.

tools.name: reset_patterns
tools.description: Clear all sequencer lanes (note, pitch, slice, stretch) for a single cell.

tools.name: update_effect_config
tools.description: Toggle cell effects on/off (filter, delay, crusher, flanger, eq, fdn, gate, compressor). Uses the lighter KV path that does not rebuild the audio graph. Pass 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

tools.name: update_cell_config
tools.description: Update cell-level configuration properties like polyphony, MIDI settings, varispeed, and modulation latch. These are KV-only properties that don't appear in the parameter manifest. Uses a lightweight KV path without graph rebuild.

midiNote.description: MIDI trigger note for the cell.

varispeed.description: Varispeed mode (pitch = speed) vs independent pitch shift.

polyRootNote.description: Root note for poly pitch calculation.

scaleName.description: Scale name for pitch sequencer quantization (e.g. 'chromatic', 'major', 'minor').

quantScale.description: Pitch quantize scale when pitchMode=2 (Pitch Shift Quantize) or 3 (Varispeed Quantize): 0=Chromatic, 1=Major, 2=Minor, 3=Penta Maj, 4=Penta Min, 5=Dorian, 6=Mixolydian, 7=Blues, 8=Harm Min, 9=Phrygian. Order locked to QuantScale in modules/helpers/Scale.h.

quantRoot.description: Pitch quantize root when pitchMode=2 (Pitch Shift Quantize) or 3 (Varispeed Quantize): 0=C, 1=C#, ..., 11=B.

grainDensity.description: Cloud stretch grain density when stretchMode=1.

grainWindow.description: Cloud stretch grain envelope when stretchMode=1: 0=Hann, 1=Tukey, 2=Welch, 3=Punch, 4=Swell.

spread.description: Cloud stretch grain spread (0..100) when stretchMode=1.

chaos.description: Cloud stretch grain chaos (0..100) when stretchMode=1.

sidechainFrom.description: Sidechain compressor source. null=no sidechain, 0=external audio input, 1-8=cell output. Auto-enables the cell's compressor when set to a non-null value.

tools.name: set_master_effects
tools.description: Configure the master bus Punch compressor, Limiter, and Tape colour. The Punch compressor is a musical bus compressor — use it for glue and pump. The Limiter is a 3-stage brick-wall limiter with tanh saturation. The Tape is a vintage-tape coloration stage (ADAA tanh/asymmetric saturation + HF compression + wow/flutter), the single biggest lever for lo-fi / dusty / 'pushed' master character (hip-hop, lo-fi, Memphis, dub). Pass enabled flags to toggle each on/off. Pass parameters to shape the sound. For pumpy beats: enable punch, set threshold around -18 to -12 dB, fast attack (0.1-0.5ms), medium release (80-200ms), ratio 4-8, autoMakeup true. For lo-fi/Memphis/dusty glue: tapeEnabled=1, tapeMode=1 (Lo-Fi), masterTapeDrive 0.55-0.7, masterTapeTone -0.4..-0.1 (darker), masterTapeWear 0.5-0.7 (wow/flutter). NOTE: the Tape requires a PAM build that ships it (manifest key masterTapeEnabled). On older builds these keys are ignored.

masterTapeDrive.description: Tape drive / saturation amount (0-1, default 0.5). Higher = more harmonic grit + HF compression ('push it harder → it gets duller').

masterTapeTone.description: Tape tone tilt (-1 dark .. 0 flat .. +1 bright, default 0). Go negative for dusty/lo-fi.

masterTapeMode.description: Tape character: 0=Clean (gentle tanh), 1=Lo-Fi (most degradation, dusty), 2=Amp (hard asymmetric drive). Default 0.

masterTapeWear.description: Tape wear: wow/flutter pitch drift + age (0-1, default 0.5). Raise for warble/sag.

tools.name: set_drum_synth
tools.description: Select and shape a cell's built-in drum-synth 'machine' — a real-time synthesized voice that sums into the cell alongside (or instead of) its sample. 18 engines: Off, Kick, Snare, HiHat, Clap, Tom, FM, Cymbal, Cowbell, 808, Shaker, Rim, Conga, Bell, Pluck, Zap, Wave, Chaos. The 808 engine is a tuned long-glide sub that plays as a chromatic bassline (drive it with a pitch lane + pitch-quantize) — ideal for 808 sub-bass, trap, Memphis. Use a cell with NO sample for a pure synth voice, or layer over a sample. Each engine reinterprets the 8 generic params (p1..p8); pass only the ones you want to nuance — unspecified params seed to the engine's musical default. Per-engine p-labels: Kick=[Tune,Pitch,P.Decay,Decay,Click,Drive,Tone]; Snare=[Tune,Snap,Body,N.Decay,N.Tone,Detune,Drive]; HiHat=[Tune,Decay,Tone,Metal,Noise]; Clap=[Tune,Spread,Decay,Tone,Drive]; Tom=[Tune,Pitch,Decay,Tone,Noise,Drive]; FM=[Tune,Ratio,FM Amt,Decay,FM Dcy,F.Back,Drive]; Cymbal=[Tune,Decay,Tone,Metal,Sizzle]; Cowbell=[Tune,Decay,Ratio,Tone,Drive]; 808=[Tune,Glide,P.Decay,Decay,Saturate,Click,Tone]; Shaker=[Tune,Color,Decay,Attack,Rattle,Tone]; Rim=[Tune,Ring,Decay,Mode,Snap,Drive]; Conga=[Tune,Slap,Decay,Mode,Tone,Skin,Drive]; Bell=[Tune,Ratio,FM Amt,Decay,Inharm,Strike,Tone]; Pluck=[Tune,Sustain,Damp,Excite,Tone,Drive,Decay]; Zap=[Tune,Sweep,S.Time,Decay,Timbre,Noise,Drive,Tone]; Wave=[Tune,Position,P.Env,Decay,Bright,Morph,Drive]; Chaos=[Tune,Chaos,Decay,Tone,Drive,Noise]. NOTE: requires a PAM build with drum synth (manifest.drumSynth.enabled) — a standard PAM feature, no settings flag. On builds without it, the cell{N}_synthEngine state key is ignored.

engine.description: Engine name. 'Off' disables the synth voice (sample-only cell).

p1.description: Param 1 (engine-specific; usually Tune). Overrides the engine default.

tools.name: add_param_seq
tools.description: Add a parameter sequencer (step modulation) targeting any modulatable parameter. Generates rhythmic value changes synced to transport. Steps are normalized 0-1 values. If a paramSeq already exists for this paramId, it is replaced.

sequence.description: Step values (0-1). Defaults to 16 steps of 0.5.

tools.name: update_param_seq
tools.description: Update an existing parameter sequencer's step values or properties. Use add_param_seq first if no paramSeq exists for this paramId.

tools.name: remove_param_seq
tools.description: Remove a parameter sequencer for the given paramId.

tools.name: normalize_sample
tools.description: Normalize a cell's sample to peak amplitude (non-destructive).

tools.name: gain_sample
tools.description: Apply a gain in decibels to a cell's sample and render it into a new file (offline, destructive). Positive values make it louder, negative quieter; boosting past 0 dBFS clips. The original library file is left unchanged, so the edit can be undone by reloading the source sample.

gainDb.description: Gain in decibels (e.g. 3 = +3 dB louder, -6 = 6 dB quieter).

tools.name: export_audio
tools.description:
Render and export audio from the current preset to a WAV file in PAM's Exports folder. Waits for completion. Default mode renders the looping preset for `bars` bars at the current BPM. Set `mode` to bounce stems or the whole Song Mode arrangement.

Modes: 'main' (full mix, default) · 'individual' (one cell solo, needs cellId) · 'all-cells' / 'selected-cells' (per-cell stems, the latter needs selectedCellIds) · 'per-bus' (per output bus) · 'song-mode' (the Song Mode timeline).

NOTE on 'song-mode': the OFFLINE bounce only renders the arrangement's FIRST section's live state — variation/preset switches are not applied offline (the message thread is blocked during render). For a true full track that captures every section change, use the `export_song` tool (live capture).

bars.description: Bars to render (ignored for 'song-mode', which derives length from the timeline).

cellId.description: Render only a specific cell in solo (implies mode 'individual'). Omit for full mix.

mode.description: Export mode. Defaults to 'main' (or 'individual' when cellId is set).

selectedCellIds.description: For mode 'selected-cells': cells to bounce as stems.

tools.name: arm_looper_track
tools.description: Arm or disarm a looper track for recording. Arming alone does not start recording — call start_looper_recording afterwards (or use arm_and_record).

armed.description: true to arm, false to disarm.

tools.name: set_looper_track
tools.description: Update one or more per-track looper fields (mute, overdub mode, reverse, pitch, warp, capture source, level). Pass only the fields you want to change.

solo.description: Solo / unsolo (toggle others off if true).

overdubMode.description: Overdub vs replace behavior on next recording.

sourceCell.description: Capture source: 0 = external input, 1-8 = cell output. (UI-side inverted vs captureSource.)

autoSelect.description: Enable auto-select cycling of clip regions.

recordedBpm.description: Override the recorded BPM for the track (0 = unset).

tools.name: clear_looper_track
tools.description: Clear the recorded clip and any selection state for a looper track. Does NOT delete the audio file from disk (the C++ side handles file cleanup separately).

tools.name: set_looper_track_selection
tools.description: Set the in/out selection (in loop-normalized 0..1 coordinates) for a looper track.

tools.name: start_looper_recording
tools.description: Queue a looper recording. Recording starts at the next bar boundary when the transport is playing, or immediately when stopped. Tracks must be armed first (or pass armedCellIds to arm + record). Each track's captureSource: 0 = cell output (post-FX), 1 = external input.

trackMetadata.description: Per-track metadata. Defaults: replace mode, cell-output source. Pass existingClipPaths to enable overdub on a prior layer.

tools.name: stop_looper_recording
tools.description: Stop or cancel the active looper recording session.

tools.name: capture_looper_now
tools.description: Capture audio that is already in the rolling buffer (requires looper_always_listen=true). Fires immediately if the buffer holds enough audio for the requested bars; otherwise arms and waits.

mode.description: 'match' = follow each track's overdubMode, 'overdub' = layer on existing, 'replace' = overwrite.

tools.name: load_audio_to_looper_track
tools.description: Load an audio file directly into a looper track (skips recording). File must be a wav/mp3/aif/flac under the PAM base path or absolute.

tools.name: request_looper_warp
tools.description: Render an offline warp for a looper track's clip at the current host BPM. Result lands in state.loopers[cellId].warpedClipPath when ready.

tools.name: looper_settings
tools.description: Configure looper-wide behavior: always-listen rolling buffer, input-latency compensation.

alwaysListen.description: Keep capturing audio into a rolling buffer (required for capture_looper_now).

latencyCompAuto.description: Auto-compensate for input latency (defaults ON for external input).

latencyCompApplyToCells.description: Apply latency comp also when capture source is a cell output.

tools.name: looper_variation
tools.description: Manage looper variation slots (clip-set snapshots). Operations: 'apply' (immediate), 'queue' (bar-synced), 'cancel', 'clear', 'setCurrent', 'save' (snapshot current looper state into the slot).

data.description: For 'save': the looper variation snapshot (object). Pass null to clear instead.

tools.name: looper_variation_sync
tools.description: Configure how looper variation switches synchronize to bar boundaries.

tools.name: queue_variation
tools.description: Schedule a global variation switch on the next bar boundary. For an immediate switch, use load_variation instead.

tools.name: cancel_queued_variation
tools.description: Cancel a pending bar-synced variation switch.

tools.name: update_variations
tools.description: Replace the entire 8-slot variations table with a new array. Each entry is a JSON-stringified variation snapshot (or null for an empty slot). Most agents should prefer save_variation for individual slots.

variations.description: Array of 8 entries (JSON string or null).

tools.name: variation_hold
tools.description: 'Hold while note pressed' mode for variations. Use this to map MIDI notes to momentary variation switches that revert when the note releases.

allNotesOff.description: Force-release any held trigger notes (useful after a stuck MIDI note).

bindings.description: Per-variation-slot MIDI bindings (slot 0..7). Array is padded with unassigned slots if shorter than 8.

tools.name: trigger_midi_cc
tools.description: Send a MIDI Control Change message into PAM's MIDI router. Maps to any MIDI-learned parameter or looper/variation CC bindings.

tools.name: trigger_midi_program_change
tools.description: Send a MIDI Program Change message (e.g. for preset switching).

tools.name: midi_recording
tools.description: Control live MIDI recording into the active sequencer. Ops: 'start' (optional opts), 'stop' (with commit flag), 'setOverdub', 'removeNote'.

tools.name: update_modulation
tools.description: Apply a delta to a modulation source: LFO, Envelope, Vary, Macro, ParamSeq config, or ParamSeq sequence data. The payload is type-specific; see modulation update flows in interop.ts (applyLfoUpdate / updateEnvelope / etc.). Use add_modulation to first attach a source to a target — then this tool to edit it.

payload.description: Update payload object. Shape depends on type: lfo expects { index, rate?, depth?, shape?, customCurve?, target? }, envelope expects matrix entry edits, paramSeqSequence expects { id, steps[] }, etc.

tools.name: song_mode
tools.description: Control PAM's song mode (timeline of variation/preset steps). Ops: 'setSequence', 'clear', 'toggle', 'setLoopPoints', 'toggleLoop', 'setCrossfadeMs', 'setPlayhead'.

startPositionPPQ.description: Start position in PPQ (4 PPQ = 1 bar at 4/4).

presetPath.description: If non-empty, load this preset instead of switching variation.

ppq.description: For 'setPlayhead': PPQ position to scrub to.

tools.name: export_song
tools.description:
Bounce the full Song Mode arrangement to a single WAV — the 'render my whole track' button. Set up the arrangement first with the `song_mode` tool (setSequence), then call this.

Two strategies:
• 'live' (DEFAULT, full fidelity): plays the arrangement in real time and captures the master mix, so EVERY section/variation/preset change and all modulation is rendered. Needs a free `cellId` to land the captured clip in (use an empty cell). Capture is capped at 64 bars; for longer songs bounce in sections or raise the cap. The captured WAV also lands in PAM's Resamples folder.
• 'offline' (fast, LIMITED): renders via the offline song-mode bounce. Only the first section's state is rendered (variation/preset switches are NOT applied offline). Use only for single-section sketches.

After a 'live' bounce, the captured file path is read back from the destination cell; run get_audio_info (resolve against the Resamples location from get_default_locations) to verify it.

bars.description: Total arrangement length in bars (the full timeline). Required for 'live'.

cellId.description: For 'live': empty destination cell the bounced master clip is written into.

tailBars.description: For 'live': extra bars captured after the arrangement end for reverb/release tails.

tools.name: set_metronome
tools.description: Toggle PAM's internal metronome on or off.

tools.name: analyze_sample_tempo
tools.description: Run BPM detection and transient/slice analysis on an audio file. Result is dispatched asynchronously into PAM's state — fetch it via get_state after a short delay (~100-500ms). Use this before resample_sample_to_bpm if you don't already know the source BPM.

maxSlices.description: Cap on number of detected slices.

tools.name: get_sample_peaks
tools.description: Read a sample's waveform peak data for display/analysis. Returns an array of min/max peaks at the requested resolution. Searches VFS first, then loads from disk.

samplesPerPixel.description: Resolution control — if set, peaks downsampled to ~ numSamples/samplesPerPixel bins (clamped 64..8192). Default 0 = 8192 pixels.

tools.name: preview_slice
tools.description: Audition a single slice of a cell's sample.

tools.name: resample_sample_to_bpm
tools.description: Time-stretch a cell's sample to the current project BPM (or a target BPM). Non-destructive — use restore_original_sample to revert.

sourceBpm.description: Source BPM. If omitted, PAM uses the analyzed/declared BPM in state.

targetBpm.description: Target BPM (defaults to current project BPM).

tools.name: restore_original_sample
tools.description: Revert a cell's sample to its un-edited source (undoes resample / trim / etc.).

tools.name: build_sample_chain
tools.description: Concatenate multiple audio files into one chained sample loaded onto a cell. Useful for sample-flip kits.

tools.name: export_slice
tools.description: Export a single slice of a cell's sample as a standalone WAV.

tools.name: live_resample
tools.description:
Capture PAM's audio graph output into a cell as a new sample, in real time. Ops: 'start' / 'stop'. Transport MUST be playing for the capture to produce audio. Because the capture runs live, Song Mode section changes, modulation, and variation switches are all captured faithfully — this is the building block for full-track / Song Mode bounces (see export_song).

`source` selects what to record: 'cell' (the destination cell's own output), 'input' (PAM's audio input), or 'fullmix' (the whole master mix — use this to bounce the entire arrangement).

cellId.description: For 'start': destination cell the captured clip lands in. Use an empty/scratch cell for a full-mix bounce.

bars.description: For 'start': capture length in bars (max 64; the capture also stops on the 'stop' op).

source.description: For 'start': capture source. 'fullmix' records the entire master output (the whole song).

normalize.description: For 'start': peak-normalize the captured clip after recording.

finalize.description: For 'stop': finalize the captured clip (false discards).

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.description: List plugins that have been discovered by PAM's scanner (VST3, AudioUnit, and CLAP). Returns `plugins` (each: name, manufacturer, format, category, fileOrIdentifier, isInstrument, version) and `blocklist` (paths the scanner marked unsafe). Use this before `load_plugin` to find a valid `path` + `format`. If the list is empty, call `scan_plugins` first. Note: PAM's MCP hosts plugins in the per-cell instrument slot only — FX-side hosting is not exposed yet.

isInstrument.description: If true, only instruments; false, only effects.

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the plugin name.

tools.name: scan_plugins
tools.description: Trigger an async scan for VST3, AudioUnit, and CLAP plugins. Returns immediately — poll `get_plugin_scan_status` for progress and call `list_plugins` once `isScanning` is false. Without `searchPaths`, scans default OS plugin folders. Supplied `searchPaths` must live under PAM's approved plugin roots (/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/{VST3,Components,CLAP} or their ~ equivalents on macOS; C:/Program Files/Common Files/{VST3,CLAP} on Windows).

searchPaths.description: Folders to scan. Must be inside an approved plugin root. Leave empty to use OS defaults (/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/* on macOS, etc.).

blocklist.description: File paths or identifiers the scanner should skip.

tools.name: cancel_plugin_scan
tools.description: Cancel the in-flight plugin scan. Safe to call even if no scan is running.

tools.name: get_plugin_scan_status
tools.description: Read the latest plugin scan progress. Returns `isScanning`, `format`, `currentPath`, `fraction` (0..1), `elapsedMs`, `isStall` (true when the in-flight plugin hasn't returned in 2s), and `updatedAtMs`. Poll while a scan is running.

tools.name: list_loaded_plugins
tools.description: List plugins currently hosted in PAM cells (instrument slot only — FX-side hosting is not exposed). Each entry: cellId, name, manufacturer, format, path, isInstrument, bypassed, and the plugin's full param list (index, name, label, value, defaultValue). Use the param `index` with `set_plugin_param`.

tools.name: load_plugin
tools.description: Load a hosted plugin (VST3, AudioUnit, or CLAP) into a cell's instrument slot. Blocks until the plugin probes + instantiates (can take seconds for heavy plugins) and returns success or the underlying error. `path` must be a `fileOrIdentifier` returned by a previous `list_plugins` call in this session.

tools.name: unload_plugin
tools.description: Unload the hosted plugin from a cell. No-op if no plugin is loaded there.

tools.name: set_plugin_param
tools.description: Set a parameter on a hosted plugin by cell + parameter index. Value is normalized 0..1. Use `list_loaded_plugins` to find param indices and names. This is the dedicated path for hosted plugin params — `set_parameters` won't reach them. Targets the cell's instrument-slot plugin only.

tools.name: set_plugin_bypass
tools.description: Toggle bypass on the hosted plugin in a cell (instrument slot). Bypassed plugins are silenced; the cell sampler still plays in parallel.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Merge a partial settings delta into PAM's plugin settings (the Settings panel state) and apply it live. Returns the full merged settings object so you can discover available keys. This is the only way to flip experimental-feature gates from an agent. Common boolean keys: experimentalMode, experimentalPluginHost, experimentalMcpBridge. To enable the plugin host, set BOTH experimentalMode:true AND the specific sub-flag (e.g. experimentalPluginHost:true) in one call. The drum synth needs no flag — it is a standard feature on PAM. Other keys include UI/library preferences — call get_state or inspect the returned object for the current set.

settings.description: Partial settings object to merge. Example: { experimentalMode: true, experimentalPluginHost: true }

tools.name: configure_transport
tools.description: Configure transport behaviour beyond BPM (use set_bpm for tempo). Set the time signature, toggle host-sync (when off, preset/user BPM overrides the host), toggle external clock sync, mute the audio output (standalone), or release host-sync ownership for manual transport. All fields are optional — only the provided ones are applied.

hostSyncEnabled.description: When false, preset/user BPM overrides the host tempo.

externalClockSync.description: Sync the internal transport to external MIDI clock.

muteAudioOutput.description: Standalone only: mute the master output.

releaseHostSyncForManualTransport.description: When true, release host-sync ownership so the internal transport can be driven manually.

tools.name: get_audio_device_setup
tools.description: Get the standalone audio/MIDI device setup (sample rate, buffer size, available and active input/output devices). Returns null when running plugin-hosted (the DAW owns the device config). Use the device IDs/names from here with set_midi_io.

tools.name: set_midi_io
tools.description: Select MIDI input/output devices (standalone). Use get_audio_device_setup to discover device IDs first. All fields optional.

inputDeviceIds.description: Enabled MIDI input device IDs (replaces the active set).

tools.name: set_midi_mapping
tools.description: Configure the global MIDI-controller mappings that trigger PAM actions: variation switch, preset change, looper record, live resample, and looper-variation switch. Set the enable flag, MIDI channel, CC number, preset source, or bar-sync for each target. One field per call.

field.description: Field to set. 'source' is preset-only; 'barSync' is variation/looperVariation-only; looper/resample have no source/barSync.

value.description: boolean for enabled/barSync; number for channel (1-16), ccNumber (0-127), or source.

tools.name: delete_preset
tools.description: Delete a user preset file from disk. Factory presets are protected and cannot be deleted. Use the relative path returned by list_presets.

tools.name: set_preset_factory_status
tools.description: Mark a preset as factory (read-only) or user (editable) on disk. Affects the factory flag and the file location.

tools.name: get_sample_usage
tools.description: Cross-reference samples and presets. mode 'presetUsesSamples' lists the samples a preset references; mode 'presetsUsingSample' lists presets that reference a given sample (or any sample under a folder).

path.description: Relative preset path (presetUsesSamples) or relative sample path (presetsUsingSample).

isFolder.description: presetsUsingSample only: treat 'path' as a folder and match any sample beneath it.

tools.name: repair_preset_samples
tools.description: Fix broken sample references in presets. mode 'fix' auto-relinks moved/renamed samples by searching the library (optionally scoped to one preset). mode 'rescan' re-audits a preset for still-missing samples and reports them. Useful after moving a sample library or importing presets from another machine.

presetPath.description: Relative preset path. Omit for 'fix' to scan all presets; omit for 'rescan' to audit the active preset.

tools.name: preview_sample
tools.description: Audition an audio file through PAM's native preview player without loading it into a cell. Pass filePath to start previewing; pass stop:true to stop the current preview.

filePath.description: Absolute or library-relative path to the audio file to preview.

stop.description: Stop the current preview instead of starting one.

tools.name: set_plugin_params
tools.description: Set multiple hosted-plugin parameters in one call (more efficient than set_plugin_param per value). Values are 0..1 normalized. Use list_loaded_plugins to discover paramIndex values. role defaults to 'instrument'.

values.description: Array of { paramIndex, value } where value is 0..1 normalized.

tools.name: skip_current_plugin_scan
tools.description: Skip (blocklist) the plugin currently being scanned and continue the scan. Use when a scan is stuck on a crashing/hanging plugin (poll get_plugin_scan_status to detect a stall).

tools.name: remove_plugin_from_blocklist
tools.description: Un-blocklist a plugin that was blocklisted after a failed/crashed scan so it can be scanned and loaded again. Pass the fileOrIdentifier as it appears in the blocklist (see list_plugins → blocklist).

fileOrIdentifier.description: The blocklisted plugin's file path or identifier.

instructions: PAM is an audio sampler plugin. When browsing samples, ALWAYS call get_default_locations first to discover the user's actual library paths — never guess paths like ~/Music/PAM. The sample library lives under ~/Library/Application Support/, NOT ~/Music/. Use the returned paths with list_samples. When loading samples, use load_sample with paths from list_samples. Transport must be playing for sequencer output. To enable experimental features (plugin host, AI engines) call update_settings with both experimentalMode:true AND the specific sub-flag (e.g. experimentalPluginHost:true). The drum synth is a standard feature (PAM ≥ 1.5) — no settings flag needed. Tools added in server version 1.7.0 — update_settings, configure_transport, get_audio_device_setup, set_midi_io, set_midi_mapping, delete_preset, set_preset_factory_status, get_sample_usage, repair_preset_samples, preview_sample, set_plugin_params, skip_current_plugin_scan, remove_plugin_from_blocklist — require PAM ≥ 1.7.0. VX video tools (get_video_state, video_command, add_video_layer, update_video_layer, remove_video_layer, apply_video_layout, add_video_fx, set_video_fx, remove_video_fx, bind_video_param, set_video_settings) require PAM ≥ 1.8.0 AND PAM's window to be OPEN (the video engine renders in the WebView; there is no headless renderer). For audio-reactive control, note the visual audio-react params (visualWaveDisplace, etc.) are regular plugin params — drive them with set_parameters; layers/FX/bindings go through the video tools. When building a scene, call get_video_state first to learn layer/fx ids. Earlier tool sets (looper, song mode, modulation edits, MIDI recording, sample analysis, live resample, variation scheduling, AI generation) require PAM ≥ 1.4.50 / 1.5.0. If a tool fails with "PAM build does not support 'X'", the connected plugin is older than this MCP server; the user must update PAM (updating the npm package alone is not enough).
